step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows data flowing from on-premise Source/ETL systems into AWS S3, which then loads data into an S4 HANA database running on EC2 (X1 family). S3 data is replicated to a secondary S3 bucket in a disaster recovery region. The HANA database on EC2 is configured with high availability and HANA replication to a secondary database instance. The infrastructure is provisioned using AWS CloudFormation and monitored using Amazon CloudWatch.
